T: Mind the popcorn. Mind the doll.
D: A young couple's new house fills with dread after a vintage doll is given to them as a gift.
P: Serve the popcorn when Mia puts a pan of it on the stove.
S: Stovetop maple bacon brown butter popcorn
the pan of popcorn left on the stove too long

Popcorn popped in a heavy pot and tossed in nutty brown butter, maple syrup, crumbled crisp bacon and flaky salt. Never walk away from the stove. Fry 4 rashers of streaky bacon until very crisp, then crumble. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a heavy pot over medium heat, add 120g popcorn kernels, cover and shake constantly until the popping slows, then pull it off straight away. Cook 60g butter in a small pan until golden brown and nutty, then stir in 2 tbsp maple syrup. Pour over the popcorn, toss with the bacon and a good pinch of flaky salt.
Devilled eggs with paprika, cocktail franks in a sticky barbecue and grape jelly glaze, and celery boats filled with cream cheese and olives.

Puff pastry twisted with parmesan, sharp cheddar, paprika and a little mustard, baked crisp and golden and stood up in a jar like knitting needles. Heat the oven to 200C. Brush 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry with beaten egg and spread one lightly with Dijon mustard. Scatter 60g grated parmesan, 60g grated cheddar and 1 tsp paprika over the mustard sheet, lay the second sheet on top and press firmly. Cut into 1.5cm strips, twist each one and lay on lined trays. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until puffed and golden, then cool on a rack.
M: Strips of scotch fillet seared fast, finished in a sour cream, mushroom and paprika sauce with a dash of brandy, over buttered egg noodles with parsley. Slice 700g scotch fillet into thin strips and sear in batches in a very hot pan for 1 minute, then set aside. Soften 1 sliced onion in 30g butter, add 300g sliced mushrooms and cook until golden. Add 2 tsp sweet paprika and 2 tbsp brandy, then 250ml beef stock and 1 tbsp Dijon and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in 200ml sour cream and the beef and warm through without boiling. Toss 400g egg noodles with butter and parsley and serve.
John's long hours at the hospital
Chicken, mushroom and rice baked together in a creamy sauce with thyme at 180C for 50 minutes, a 1960s weeknight dinner done properly.
W: the doll John finally finds for Mia's collection

Vanilla bean cupcakes baked at 170C for 18 minutes, piped with white Swiss meringue buttercream, a tiny pink sugar rose on each. Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar and vanilla bean seeds, add 2 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 170C for 18 minutes. Whisk 2 whites with 120g sugar over hot water, beat in 200g butter and pipe white. Add a tiny pink sugar rose.
K: Mint chocolate ice cream blended with milk into pale green shakes, a crème de menthe nip for adults.

note.text: Don't move the doll. She is exactly where she needs to be.

dishes.n: Stovetop maple bacon brown butter popcorn

steps.text: Fry the bacon until very crisp, then crumble.
Heat the oil in a heavy pot over medium heat, add the kernels, cover and shake constantly until the popping slows. Pull it off straight away.
Cook the butter in a small pan until golden brown and nutty, then stir in the maple syrup.
Pour over the popcorn and toss with the bacon and a good pinch of salt.
Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and halve. Whip the yolks with mayo and paprika and pipe back in.
Simmer the franks in the barbecue sauce and grape jelly until sticky.
Fill the celery boats with cream cheese and sliced olives.
Brown the chicken and set aside.
Soften the mushrooms in the same pan, then stir in the rice, stock, cream and thyme.
Pour into a baking dish, lay the chicken on top and cover.
Beat the first share of butter with the first share of sugar and the vanilla seeds, add the whole eggs and fold in the flour and milk.
Bake in a muffin tin at 170C for 18 minutes. Cool.
Whisk the egg whites with the rest of the sugar over hot water, then beat in the remaining butter to make buttercream.
Pipe white buttercream onto each cupcake and add a tiny pink sugar rose.
Blend the ice cream with the milk until thick.
Pour into glasses. For the grown-ups, blend in the crème de menthe and crème de cacao.

m.note: John's long hours at the hospital
m.how: Brown 800g chicken thighs and set aside. Soften 250g mushrooms, stir in 250g long grain rice, 500ml stock, 150ml cream and thyme. Lay the chicken on top, cover and bake at 180C for 50 minutes.

d.how: Blend 1L mint choc chip ice cream with 400ml cold milk until thick. Pour into 4 glasses. For the grown-ups, blend in 30ml crème de menthe and 30ml crème de cacao per glass.
